predecessor.reason_for_NEW_version: V1 combined a far headboard/front-to-back top with a left-side pillow and a right end called footboard, implying a conflicting sideways/daybed orientation. V2 chooses front-to-back explicitly and replaces those geometry/material descriptions.

scope.only_deliverable: NEW source-only design JSON. This is a concrete plan for a later bounded early prototype, not an executed patch or another acceptance certificate.

owner_directions.fixed_targets: Preserve model, interaction, label and selection/action anchors, scheduling and animation; keep the target visibly attached to the same recognizable bed.
owner_directions.shadow: A bed-specific attached-contact shadow adjustment is allowed in the design. No cosmetic rail may conceal the old generic detached shadow.
owner_directions.calibration: Motel first; separate calibration and fresh full populated review are mandatory for House and Apartment. No global adoption from one proportional formula.

orientation.axes: u crosses the bed from left to right; v runs from the far headboard/head edge(0) toward the near/front foot edge(1). Pillow is near v0; blanket progresses along increasing v; the near transverse wooden member is the foot rail; the right longitudinal member is a side rail.
orientation.mattress_proportion_change: The provisional near width narrows from286 to224 board pixels, far width from240 to188, and top depth grows from44 to64. This addresses the broad-bench risk before the early prototype, but does not prove adult scale or credible perspective.
orientation.remaining_scale_risk: There is no adult person in the actual Base to establish adult scale. The retained wide/tall headboard may still dominate the narrower mattress. These proportions are an untested starting point and must be judged in the actual whole room.

units.raster_snap: Whole board pixels for proposed structural vertices. Actual target input stays native Rect2/Vector2; no debug-JSON coordinate parsing.

exact_fixed_targets.visible_attachment: The original Sleep model/hit rectangle includes the new recognizable headboard top/stiles. Its posts, lower rail and mattress meet as one bed. It is not an invisible target separated from an unrelated floating mattress.
exact_fixed_targets.click_limit: The new mattress and legs extend below the old hit rectangle. No click area is enlarged and no selected outline may imply those outside pixels are interactive. Root must review the headboard/label as the fixed usable target in the early prototype.
exact_fixed_targets.selection_rule: Highlight the existing target's headboard/anchored component and keep the existing selected action/info. Do not outline the complete extended mattress as a clickable footprint.

headboard_unchanged_from_V1.structure: The lower rail physically ties panel/stiles to the bed and the posts bear at the rear contact. It is not a shadow-covering rail; the obsolete generic bed shadow is removed separately.

geometry_board.right_rail_rule: Render its body before the mattress top, then retain only a slim2-board-pixel cap along the right longitudinal edge after the top. It must read as a side rail, not a tall end wall or the footboard. The actual foot rail is the transverse front member.
structural_draw_order: Near/front frame plus right side-rail body.
Projected mattress top/rim, pillow and blanket.
Slim right side cap and real transverse front foot rail/cap.
Only the anchored headboard/target selection cue; do not imply a larger hit area.

geometry_native.separate_existing_interaction_light: Original rect-derived light remains unchanged and is not claimed as contact shadow.
geometry_native.near_foot_material: The near feet now lie22 native rows beyond the rug's preserved near border on the original wood floor. The cast/contact paint also lies on that wood. V1's feet570/shadows578/inside-rug10-row-margin claims are superseded and must not be reused.
geometry_native.negative_space: Keep the floor/rug visible between supports from the near frame bottom566 to feet610. No opaque filled box spanning leg height.

top_surface_paint.interpolation: Q(u,v) = lerp(lerp(farLeft,farRight,u),lerp(nearLeft,nearRight,u),v), using Vector2 values before whole-board snapping.

one_pillow.placement: At the far head edge, centered slightly right to keep the fixed Backpack label clear. No second pillow or baked pillow is introduced.

blanket.placement: The blanket covers the footward portion of the top plane, progressing in v. Its folded near hem also follows that transverse near direction.

top_surface_paint.three_static_seams: Place narrow seams near u0.38/0.56/0.74, following v0.38..0.94. These are projected static bedding details replacing the old upright stripes, not three new motions.

fixed_Backpack_label_clearance.limit: These are geometry/bounding-box clearances only. Actual text alpha, palette contrast, selection and populated motion must still be viewed.

top_surface_paint.material: Use the existing restrained plum bedding, pale pillow and dark practical timber family, with different values for mattress top/rim/frame. No global recolor, gold furniture, blur, added texture asset or label plaque.

bed_shadow_plan.old_generic_shadow: Replace only the admitted bed's _draw_object_shadow(rect,...) dispatch at _draw_scene_object_body; preserve the generic function/calls for all other props. The new _draw_bed_prop paints its physical attached contacts. Do not keep the obsolete y378..383 strip and do not hide it with added furniture.
bed_shadow_plan.attachment: Rear patches overlap the final2 native support rows at468; near patches overlap the final2 rows at610 and continue onto the wood floor. Soft cast is translucent and does not fill all under-bed negative space.
bed_shadow_plan.values: Existing black0.42 for tight contacts, low black~0.14 cast, no Gaussian blur or opaque floor rectangle. The original rect-based flickering interaction light remains once with unchanged cadence.
bed_shadow_plan.not_grounding_proof: Merely placing a boundary at rear contact234 is not evidence that the pixels behind or under the actual support read as floor. Actual companion material and source-bound populated images must establish that.

source_companion.status: Same exact maximum source allowance as V1; no executable donor/art patch exists.

backing_native.purpose: Remove the obsolete boxed-frame perimeter/bottom and exposed remnants around the open panel. Restore coherent plaster outside the panel; live structure supplies the headboard frame. Do not bake any mattress/pillow/legs/contact shadow.

floor_native.purpose: A small floor continuation outside the unchanged rug, paired with the new volumetric bed painter. No unchanged upright-bed-plus-shifted-wall repair.
